subject: fs-a-tensor-functor-is-just-a-strong-monoidal-functor
subclass_note: The false statement lacked a witness separating strong monoidality from the page's k-linear tensor-functor convention. The reader supplied complex conjugation on finite-dimensional complex vector spaces, which is strong monoidal but not complex-linear on Hom spaces.

subject: fs-every-finite-k-linear-abelian-category-is-semisimple
subclass_note: The reader supplied a witness satisfying the page's exact finiteness definition: finite-dimensional modules over k[epsilon]/(epsilon^2), whose regular module is a nonsplit self-extension of the unique simple module. Alpha also completed the required risk review.

subject: fs-every-rigid-k-linear-abelian-monoidal-category-is-a-tensor-category
subclass_note: The reader replaced the inadequate witness with Vect_fd(k) x Vect_fd(k), which is rigid, k-linear, abelian, and monoidal but has End(1)=k x k and therefore fails the stated tensor-category convention.

subject: fs-the-grothendieck-ring-of-a-tensor-category-is-always-commutative

subject: def-barycentric-subdivision-prism-homotopy
